items: 【Efficient Processor】The TOSHIBA Dynabook K50 2 in 1 laptops quipped with Intel Celeron N4020 dual-core processor, this notebook delivers reliable performance for everyday tasks. Efficiently manage web browsing, video streaming, educational app usage and video conferencing with smooth, responsive operation

【Responsive Memory & Storage】The windows tablet with 4GB RAM, enjoy smooth multitasking between your browser tabs and Android apps. 64GB of built-in eMMC storage provides ample space for your files, apps and downloads, ensuring you space for what matters most

【Ports】USB Type-C, USB Type-A, Audio Jack, microSD card slot, HDMI (on dock); This mini laptop with multiple connectivity options for easy connection to projectors, monitors, USB flash drives and peripherals for learning and presentations
【10.1" Touchscreen Display】Designed to be perfect for watching your favorite TV shows. Its 10.1-inch HD display has a resolution of 1280 x 720 with vibrant colors for an excellent visual experience
【Operating System】This refurbished tablet has Windows 11 Pro pre-installed. Enhanced security, remote management and virtualization capabilities for more complex and demanding work environments
